description: This file defines the Criteria class, which encapsulates search or filtering criteria with properties such as start index, maximum count, code, and order by preference. It appears to be used as a data model within the application.

classes.name: Criteria
classes.description: A data container for specifying search criteria, including pagination, code filtering, and sorting order.

methods.name: getMaxCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of results to retrieve.

methods.name: setMaxCount
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of results to retrieve.

methods.name: getStartIndex
methods.description: Returns the starting index for results pagination.

methods.name: setStartIndex
methods.description: Sets the starting index for results pagination.

methods.name: setOrderBy
methods.description: Sets the order by preference for sorting results.
